title: AT-AT Cannon
caption: AT-AT Cannon (V)
game_text: Deploy on your non-{maintenance} AT-AT. May target a character or vehicle at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 (+2 if a vehicle) > defense value. If just lost from table, place this weapon in Used Pile.
lore: Laser cannons mounted on the head of an Imperial walker provide devastating, coordinated firepower. Effective against a wide variety of targets.

notes: Non-unique. Inline gold wheel after 'non-' → {maintenance} ('your non-{maintenance} AT-AT'). Lore matches the scan. The wiki's default 'AT-AT Cannon' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text and the 745 px Hoth-D-atatcannon.gif is the PC Errata face (D-E1) — downloaded, not used; printed face = 'AT-AT Cannon (Original)' → Hoth-D-atatcannon-decipher-archive.gif (350×490) used. Modern: V22-D-atatcannon.gif (745) used; VB2 -pre and non-pre (350) also downloaded. Copyright 1996 legible on the 745 face.
